scope: Preserve public command evidence, deduplicate activity replay, and display streamed response status and paged history in Workspace.

keep: Existing Agent V2 and Swarm streams, tenant controls and native OpenUI validation.
extend: Existing canonical event adapter, terminal presentation and saved history validation.
replace: Free-text command correlation and raw saved activity objects.

schemaImpact.rollback: Earlier readers can ignore the optional exit code.

tenant.description: Existing tenant-scoped event transport and per-turn history.

credentials.description: Existing redaction is also applied when reading saved rows.

egress.description: No new destinations or external requests.

tests.scope: Check that actual local process output, nonzero exit and replay survive the existing adapter.

architecture.reason: Uses the existing event contract, adapter and conversation history.

rollout: Review a draft stacked on the native OpenUI source. Verify isolated staging and release gates.
rollback: Revert the UI commits independently of the Native OpenUI base. Existing event and history readers remain compatible.
knownGaps: Hosted model, Search, two-account, extension cursor synchronization and authenticated reconnect acceptance need the release candidate and applicable authorization.

blockers: Hosted acceptance and coordinated extension integration pending.
